/*selectBuyerMdCmAllGoodsSearchList*/ SELECT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO , X.DESCRIPTION , X.SPECIFICATION , X.MAKER_PART_NO , X.MAKER_NAME , X.ORIGIN_NAME , X.UNIT_MEASURE , X.DELIVERY_LT , X.MIN_ORDER_QTY , X.PUR_UNIT_QTY , X.UNIT_PRICE , X.ADD_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM , S.BUYER_ITEM_NO , S.DESCRIPTION , S.SPECIFICATION , S.MAKER_PART_NO , S.MAKER_NAME , S.ORIGIN_NAME , S.UNIT_MEASURE , S.DELIVERY_LT , S.MIN_ORDER_QTY , S.PUR_UNIT_QTY , S.UNIT_PRICE , S.ADD_DATE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 품목코드 , A.DESCRIPTION -- 품목명 , A.SPECIFICATION -- 규격 , B.MAKER_PART_NO -- 모델번호 , A.MAKER_NAME -- 제조사 , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME -- 원산지 , A.UNIT_MEASURE -- 단위 , A.DELIVERY_LT -- 배송일수 , A.MIN_ORDER_QTY -- 최소주문 , A.PUR_UNIT_QTY -- 주문배수 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- 단가 , B.ADD_DATE -- 등록일 FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS <> 'D' -- 승인건만 산출시 AND A.STATUS <> 'D' -- 승인건만 산출시 AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','T') AND A.BUYER IN ( SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE IN (SELECT COD3.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'MPAG' AND COD3.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD3.FLAG = 'Y') ) AND A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN (SELECT COD3.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'MPAG' AND COD3.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD3.FLAG = 'Y')
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%'
AND UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND UPPER(A.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND (A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%' OR UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%' OR UPPER(A.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%')
AND B.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) S ) X
